notes.title: Ratty Catty Remake Devlog #6 - Introducing Motion Matching in Ratty Catty!
notes.notes:
I'm thrilled to introduce Motion Matching to Ratty Catty Remoused! This advanced animation technique selects the most suitable animation frames from a vast database, ensuring our characters move fluidly and realistically in real-time. This means smoother, more lifelike movements that will make your gameplay experience even more immersive.

[previewyoutube=sG9T02a0nlE;full][/previewyoutube]

Furthermore, I'm currently working on perfecting the animations to ensure they are as flawless as possible. While this feature is still in its early stages, I'm committed to making significant improvements.

Thank you once again for your unwavering support. Together, we'll make Ratty Catty a game to remember!

Until next time,

[i]Kerim Kumbasar.[/i]

notes.title: Ratty Catty Remake Devlog #5
notes.notes:
In this phase of development, I've been pouring my creativity and effort into crafting the intricate levels of Ratty Catty Remoused, and I'm thrilled to announce that the house level is now halfway to completion!

The house level serves as a pivotal setting in Ratty Catty, providing a challenging and immersive environment for players to explore. From the cozy corners of the living room to the treacherous heights of the attic, every corner of the house is being meticulously designed to offer a rich and dynamic gameplay experience.

Progress Update: As of now, I've completed the foundational layout of the house level, including the main rooms and corridors. Players can expect a diverse range of obstacles and hiding spots as they navigate through the various sections of the house. Additionally, I've begun implementing interactive elements and environmental hazards to further enhance the gameplay.

notes.title: Fixed a crash that occurred when launching the game on certain devices
notes.notes:
Hello players,

I'm releasing a new update for Ratty Catty that aims to fix several crashing and game closing issues that some of you have been experiencing. I apologize for any inconvenience these issues may have caused and appreciate your patience as I worked to resolve them.

Here are the specific changes included in this update:

Fixed a crash that occurred when launching the game on certain devices
Resolved an issue that caused the game to close unexpectedly during gameplay
Improved overall stability and performance
I hope these changes will provide a better gaming experience for all of our players. As always, please don't hesitate to reach out to me if you continue to encounter any issues or have any feedback.

Thank you for your support!

Sincerely,

notes.title: Ratty Catty Remake
notes.notes:
Hello folks! the Ratty Catty had some problems; the engine version was old, the models were low polygon, and it was behind the times compared with today.

I decided to remake Ratty Catty with UE5. The game will have better quality and remastered models, new character models, lighting, animations, improved and revamped gameplay, etc.

In addition to these, Ratty Catty was only available on Steam, now with the cross-platform support, it will be available on Xbox, Microsoft Store, Epic Store, Steam, iOS, Android, and Nintendo Switch.

With the Split-Screen option, it can also be played with up to 4 players. Also, the game will support up to 8 players as multiplayer.

I'm leaving a few working progress videos here.
